name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hxn GPU drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: Browser presentation uses hxn-window for canvas sizing and input on Ash wasm and Emscripten. SurfaceTargets.ofWindow accepts native and browser windows.
